## Juvenile River Dragon (CR 8)

**XP** 4,800  
 CN Medium dragon (aquatic, fire)  
 **Init** +6; **Senses** dragon senses, watersight; Perception +16; **Aura** frightful presence (120 ft., DC 17)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 25, touch 12, flat-footed 23 (+2 Dex, +13 natural)  
 **hp** 160 (10d12+40)  
 **Fort** +11, **Ref** +9, **Will** +10  
 **Immune** fire, dragon traits  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerability to fire  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., swim 60 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +15 (1d8+7)  
 **Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (60-ft. line, DC 19, 8d6 fire)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 10th; concentration +12)  

  
  At will—
  *[obscuring mist](../../magic/spells/obscuring-mist.md)*,
  *[soften earth and stone](../../magic/spells/soften-earth-and-stone.md)*
  

 **Sorcerer Spells Known** (CL 1st; concentration +3)
  

  
  1st (3/day)—
  *[expeditious retreat](../../magic/spells/expeditious-retreat.md)*,
  *[identify](../../magic/spells/identify.md)*
  

  0 (at will)—
  *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*,
  *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)*,
  *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*,
  *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)*
  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 21, **Dex** 15, **Con** 18, **Int** 13, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 14  
 **Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +15; **CMD** 27 (cannot be tripped)  
 **Feats** Athletic
